caption: The address 172.16.5.10/22 splits into 22 network bits and 10 host bits. AND with the mask gives network 172.16.4.0; setting the host bits to 1 gives broadcast 172.16.7.255, leaving 1022 usable hosts, while the classful /16 would give 172.16.0.0.

spec.title: One address, two readings
spec.aria: The address 172.16.5.10/22 splits into 22 network bits (mask 255.255.252.0) and 10 host bits (1024 addresses); AND gives network 172.16.4.0, setting host bits to 1 gives broadcast 172.16.7.255, usable hosts are 172.16.4.1 to 172.16.7.254 (1022 hosts), and the classful /16 default would give network 172.16.0.0.
